_readme: Per spec: which zeta element implements each spec part, and how a spec property maps when its name differs or it has no property. Values: 'property <name>' or 'slot <name>' (checked to exist), or a reason starting 'figma-only:', 'composed:', 'css-state:', 'not-built:' or 'derived:'. Matching names need no entry. scripts/api-coverage.mjs fails on anything unmapped.

props.Accordion Item.showDivider: derived: zeta-accordion draws dividers between items when inCard
props.Accordion Header.title: property title

parts.Icon: figma-only: the nested Icon's own props are pinned by the chip

props.label: slot (default)
props.showLeadingIcon: derived: the leading glyph shows when icon is set

parts._Avatar Type: composed: content type is the slotted img, zeta-icon or text
parts._Avatar Photos: composed: any image is slotted; the 40 photos are Figma samples

props.showStatus: derived: the badge shows when status is set

props.overflowCount: derived: generated from the slotted avatars less max
props.showAvatar3: figma-only: max and the avatars passed in decide this
props.showAvatar4: figma-only: max and the avatars passed in decide this

parts._Sheet Header: composed: the header row of zeta-bottom-sheet
parts.Sheet Handle: composed: the handle row of zeta-bottom-sheet

props.Grid Menu Item.state: css-state: hover and active on the host
props.Grid Menu Item.label: slot (default)
props._Sheet Header.showLeadingIcon: derived: shown when headerIcon is set on zeta-bottom-sheet

props.collapsed: derived: maxItems and the number of items
props.open: css-state: the overflow control toggles the menu
props.portalContainer: composed: zeta-droppable positions itself inside the element, with no portal
props._Breadcrumb Item.state: css-state: hover and focus on the link, with current and flavor for the rest
props._Breadcrumb Item.label: slot (default)

props.Group item.position: derived: first, middle and last come from the item's index
props.Group item.shape: derived: the group's rounded reaches the end items' outer corners

parts.Card Template Default: composed: assembled from zeta-card, zeta-card-header, zeta-card-body and zeta-card-footer

props._Container header.showDescription: derived: the description shows when description is set
props._Card Heading.hasLeading: derived: shows when the leading slot is filled
props._Card Heading.hasTrailing: derived: shows when the trailing slot is filled
props._Card Footer.actions: composed: the slotted buttons decide one, two or custom

props.hasLabel: derived: shows when the default slot has text
props.label: slot (default)

props.showFooter: derived: the footer is removed when no action is slotted
props._Dialog Footer.actions: derived: counted from the confirm, cancel and other slots

props.triggerComponent: derived: the trigger is the element's own zeta-button, styled by flavor and size
props.Dropdown Menu.moreItems: figma-only: the built-in rows and slot are Figma scaffolding; rows are slotted
props.Menu Item.type: property type (icon, checkbox, radio); custom is the icon slot with any element
props.Menu Item.label: slot (default)

parts.Icon: figma-only: the nested Icon's own props are pinned by the chip

parts._User Profile: composed: zeta-button with zeta-avatar and zeta-icon inside zeta-global-header

props.menuItems: derived: the region shows when menu-items is slotted
props.actionMenu: derived: the region shows when action-items is slotted

parts.icon library component sets: figma-only: the Style axis is the font family, set by rounded

props.label: derived: the native aria-label is forwarded to the inner button (required)

props.showLabel: derived: the label shows when label is set
props.showHint: derived: the hint shows when hintText is set, or errorText while error
props.partProps: derived: the field, label and hint properties are surfaced on zeta-text-input itself
props.Input / Text \u00b7 Number \u00b7 Passwo: derived: shows when leadingIcon is set
derived: shows when trailingIcon is set
props.Input Hint.type: derived: error and disabled decide it
props.showSubLabel: derived: the sub label shows when subLabel is set
props.Input Label.showSubLabel: derived: the sub label shows when subLabel is set

parts.Avatar: composed: a zeta-avatar in the leading slot
parts.Icon: figma-only: the nested Icon's own props are pinned by the chip

parts.Spacer: figma-only: unused by any Navigation Bar variant (spec issue); the right slot does its job

props.showAction: derived: the action shows when action-label is set

props.label: property showLabels
props.showSubMenu: derived: the panel shows when the sub-menu-header or sub-menu slot is filled

props.title: property headline
props._Leading Visual.flavour: derived: from the slotted element (zeta-avatar, img or zeta-icon) in slot leading

parts._controls: composed: rendered by zeta-pagination; state and style follow its outline and rounded
parts._indicators: composed: rendered by zeta-pagination from currentPage and totalPages

props.open: css-state: the country control toggles the menu
props.flag: composed: the flag field of each entry in countries
props.Input / Phone.state: composed: zeta-phone-input styles the error through the field part, and hover and focus are CSS
props._Phone Country.state: css-state: hover, pressed and focus on the control, with open, error and disabled for the rest

props.showLabel: derived: the label row shows when label is set or the trailing slot is filled

props._Upload.stop: css-state: the readout swaps for the cancel button on hover or keyboard focus

props.hasLabel: derived: shows when the default slot has text

parts.Trailing: composed: zeta-search renders the clear button, divider and voice control from value and hasIcon

parts.Dropdown Menu: composed: the options panel inside zeta-select-input
parts.Icon: figma-only: the nested Icon's own props are pinned by the field

props.showLabel: derived: the label shows when label is set
props.showHint: derived: the hint shows when hintText is set, or errorText while error
props.Input / Select.state: derived: open, error, readOnly and disabled properties; hover and focus are CSS
props.Input / Select.hasLeading: derived: shows when icon is set
props._nestedProperties: derived: label and hint part properties are surfaced on zeta-select-input (required, optional, showInformation, error, showHintIcon)
props.showSubLabel: derived: the sub label shows when subLabel is set
props.block: derived: zeta-select-input always fills its container (display: block on the host)

props.state: css-state: hover and selected follow the pointer and keyboard focus; disabled is property disabled
props._Active Track.state: derived: from the slider (spec: state belongs to the slider)
props._Thumb.state: derived: from the slider and the pointer
props.Step Indicators.dotSlots: derived: one dot per stop from min, max and stepIncrement

props.horizontalStepper.segments: composed: the same default slot; on size=compact each zeta-stepper-item draws as a segment

props.state: css-state: focus comes from keyboard focus; disabled is property disabled

props.Tab Item.state: css-state: hover is CSS; selected and disabled are properties
props.Tab Item.label: slot (default)

props.Table Content.horizontalScroll: derived: the content scrolls horizontally when its columns are wider than the table
props._Header Cell.state: css-state: hover and keyboard focus are CSS
props._Data Cell.state: css-state: hover is CSS; selected follows selectedRows when selectable, else each row; disabled each row
props._Data Cell.content: derived: text or avatar-and-text from the row, or slot cell-<row>-<col>
props._Avatar and text.subtitle: derived: the cell value subtitle
props.horizontalScroll: derived: the content scrolls horizontally when its columns are wider than the table
props.selectedCount: derived: shown while selectable rows are selected (selectedCountFormat)
props.Table Controls.selectedCount: derived: shown while selectable rows are selected (selectedCountFormat)
props._Label.filtered: derived: a column with chosen filters (property filters)
props._Select Cell.type: derived: select-all in the header, a checkbox per row (property selectable)
props._Actions Cell.type: derived: header and one cell per row (property rowActions)
props._Actions Cell.state: derived: open while its menu shows; disabled with the row; selected with the row
props._Table Menu.type: derived: row actions, filter (clientSide) and column settings (columnConfigure) menus

props.Table Controls.controls: derived: the toolbar buttons follow onRefresh, exportable and columnConfigure
props.Table Controls.controlsSlot: derived: toolbar buttons are rendered from onRefresh, exportable and columnConfigure
props.Table Content.columnPosition: derived: per column, frozen through the column configure panel
props.Table Content.horizontalScroll: derived: the content scrolls when its columns are wider than the table
props.Table Content.frozenSlotContainer: derived: frozen columns come from the column configure panel
props.Table Footer.pageDetails: derived: the page summary shows with numbered pagination
props._Header Cell.state: css-state: hover and focus are CSS; disabled follows the column
props._Data Cell.state: css-state: hover is CSS; selected follows selectable, disabled follows disabledRows
props._Data Cell.content: derived: from the column renderer and row data
props._Avatar and text.subtitle: derived: from the column renderer
props.verticalScroll: derived: the legacy table has no height cap (gap: zeta-table has maxHeight)
props.columnPosition: derived: frozen columns come from each column's frozen flag
props.horizontalScroll: derived: the content scrolls horizontally when its columns are wider than the table
props.selectedCount: derived: not shown by the legacy table (gap: zeta-table shows it)
props.controls: derived: toolbar buttons are rendered from onRefresh, exportable and columnConfigure
props.rowsPerPage: derived: the pager's rows-per-page select (property pageSize)
props.pageDetails: derived: the page summary shows with numbered pagination
props.Table Controls.selectedCount: derived: not shown by the legacy table (gap)
props.Table Content.verticalScroll: derived: no height cap in the legacy table (gap)
props._Header Cell.resize: derived: columns resize by dragging the header edge
props._Label.filtered: derived: a column with active filters (onColumnFilter)
props._Actions Cell.state: derived: from the row and its open menu
props._Table Menu.type: derived: action menu, filter panel and column configure panel

props.kind: derived: from the item's MIME type or extension (lightboxKindOf), never set — as the spec states
props.shape: rounded (Contourable): rounded=true is the spec's rounded, absent is sharp; also picks the glyph family
props.name: derived: from the current item's name, file name or URL (untitledText when none) — content, not a property
props.counter: derived: counterFormat over index/items.length — content, not a property
props.animated: animated (code-only in the spec too; the variants don't model it)
